en.topic_title: Consumer watchdog receives 286 complaints over sudden closure of Hong Kong yoga chain
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s consumer watchdog has received 286 complaints over the abrupt closure of yoga chain Hotstone Yoga, which shut its doors on Thursday.



Hotstone Yoga in Causeway Bay. Photo: Hotstone Yoga.



The Consumer Council said on Friday that the complaints involved around HK$3.9 million, adding that the Customs department was investigating the case.
